locations.note: The retracing begins with the arrival by train at Ivdel.
Retracing the Dyatlov party's steps, the player hikes into the snowy valley below Kholat Syakhl, collecting notes on a paranormal anomaly while avoiding glowing humanoid figures.

routes.name: The Dyatlov party's trail
routes.note: From the train to Ivdel up to Kholat Syakhl.
